en.title: Exact Floor of the Sum of Two Decimals
en.description:
Given two finite decimal numbers, return the floor of their sum.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and solution; bounds missing from the source and corrections to the examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: One line with two positive decimal numbers a b. Full original bounds: 0.1<a,b<1000000, with at most 8 decimal places; this site's encoding requires an integer part and does not use exponent notation.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 4; 0; 5. They were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Pad each decimal to 8 decimal places and convert it to an integer, add the integers, then divide by 10^8.
